cohort: The study included 110 hospitalized pregnant women with PCR-confirmed COVID-19 and their neonates in Lebanon, admitted during 2021.
finding: Maternal COVID-19 severity was strongly associated with adverse obstetrical and neonatal outcomes, including increased likelihood of cesarean delivery, preterm birth, neonatal PCR-positivity, NICU admission, lower APGAR scores, and lower neonatal birth weight.
mod_finding: Moderate/severe maternal COVID-19 was significantly associated with an increased likelihood of cesarean delivery.
